Harvest comparison

Only middle-row records are included. Each treatment has four experimental plots. Coloured points represent individual plots. Black diamonds show treatment means, and error bars show one standard error across plots. These are descriptive summaries.

Cumulative harvest

Thick lines show treatment means across four plots. Thin lines show individual plots. Dates without entries add no additional recorded weight; this does not establish that no harvest occurred on those dates.
